# Voiced Wave Clock Inputs v004

Exact authored plan snapshots for the three current examples/ production scenes.
The original narration remains in v003; every unit and reference is unchanged.
These inputs exercise clocks, focus lifetimes and complete narration structure
without reading ignored runtime files, executing Manim, loading audio or granting
pixel, listening or publication approval. Existing v003 tests use their own exact
historical source snapshots, never these plans with old scene bodies.

Writer: main integration operator. Consumers: offline tests and maintainers.
Lifecycle: this scene/plan revision; later revisions need matching new inputs.
Invalidation: changed authored plan, scene, shared model or clock semantics.
